question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
-- Final answer: states where both male and female legislators have retention rate > 0 at all 6 intervals
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, lt.term_start, lt.state, l.gender
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
intervals AS (
    SELECT 0 AS interval UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
legislator_intervals AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.state,
        ft.gender,
        ft.term_start,
        i.interval,
        CAST((CAST(SUBSTR(ft.term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + i.interval) || '-12-31' AS DATE) AS check_date
    FROM first_terms ft
    CROSS JOIN intervals i
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT 
        li.id_bioguide,
        li.state,
        li.gender,
        li.interval,
        li.check_date,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = li.id_bioguide
              AND CAST(lt2.term_start AS DATE) <= li.check_date
              AND CAST(lt2.term_end AS DATE) >= li.check_date
        ) AS is_retained
    FROM legislator_intervals li
),
retention_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        interval,
        1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_retained THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS retention_rate
    FROM retention_check
    GROUP BY state, gender, interval
),
state_gender_check AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        MIN(CASE WHEN retention_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_positive
    FROM retention_rates
    GROUP BY state, gender
),
valid_states AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM state_gender_check
    GROUP BY state
    HAVING SUM(all_positive) = 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT rs.state
FROM retention_rates rs
JOIN valid_states vs ON rs.state = vs.state
ORDER BY rs.state

    WHERE lt.term_number = 0

    SELECT 0 AS interval UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10

    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.state,
        ft.gender,
        ft.term_start,
        i.interval,

    FROM first_terms ft

        li.state,
        li.gender,
